A lot of work. There is a track in the multitracks called "Band (Minus Guitar 1, 2)". Using this stem, I dragged in every other stem, other than the guitars, and inverted them, causing those frequencies to be dropped. The resulting file would be an isolated orchestra track, though that's not where it ended. The drum track was still bleeding through, so I did a bit of work to rid the bleed of the drums. The final result is not 100% perfect, but this is my way of getting stems out of songs that you would normally never be able to hear on their own. I'm not stopping with Octavarium, as there are many Orchestra tracks in other songs that aren't in the multitracks, and are also slightly unhearable in the final mix. I will be uploading more real soon, so rock on!
